title: Record Windows Python 3.14 lifetime-control replay
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Supplies the explicit Windows Python 3.14 execution evidence requested by #4683: all six existing native isolated-module lifetime controls pass on **CPython 3.14.9 x64 / Windows 11 build 26300**, normally and with the outer unittest interpreter optimized. This is a portability replay of unchanged implementation and tests. It adds one evidence directory with the exact source/runtime receipt and raw captures; no new κ or selected-frontier change.

The same account authored #4683. This is additional environment coverage, not independent test design or human review.

## Task and overlap

Base/current main: `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`, priority revision 7. Contribution head: `6a1f1e8d33aa7b5ce5517d8ccc1a4f751a83009c`.

Live handoff taken before retrieving `portable-replay`; scope **refined** to one interpreter/version gap. Card scope key `91a9a2afec282c926282`, nonce `2941c600bffe1f98f2667f09cc9ccd1c`. [Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1472#discussioncomment-19134438).

Predecessor #4683: `02d43658b948db1922a23369b1fa2ba9bc4f8f58`. This executes current-main sources, whose four exact hashes are recorded. The existing native gate and ownership function have identical ASTs to that predecessor; no whole-tree identity is claimed. Related open #4779 repairs the POSIX inherited-pipe boundary and supplies different coverage. #2452's Windows 3.14 observer concerns registered-runner live-leader timeout, rather than these isolated-module exited-leader controls.

Final overlap: 425 open PR bodies, 3,957 Discussion records, complete reported remote pagination, and 5,570 of 6,319 tracked local note paths. The 749 omitted notes, arbitrary diffs and unpublished work limit coverage. Canonical main and relevant guidance/source files were unchanged at the submission refresh.

## Validation

Both serial invocations passed **6 tests, zero skips**, including the ungated-launch mutant for successful and failed module completion. Native handles observe the original module/child/grandchild identities before teardown; the controls also retain output, joined-completion, timeout and inherited-pipe checks.

```powershell
& $py314 -B -W error -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_isolated_test_windows_exit.py -v
& $py314 -O -B -W error -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_isolated_test_windows_exit.py -v
```

Here `$py314` is the recorded official NuGet CPython 3.14.9 x64 executable. Unittest durations: 17.350 s and 16.817 s. Each invocation had a 120-second external bound. `-O` and `-W error` apply to the outer interpreter; child argv and the runner's assertion-preserving policy remain unchanged.

[Evidence and reproduction](https://github.com/mihir-s-05/integer-mult-bounds/tree/6a1f1e8d33aa7b5ce5517d8ccc1a4f751a83009c/docs/research/windows314-lifetime-replay) includes runtime package/executable/DLL hashes, the four source SHA-256/Git blob identities, exact environment handling and raw logs. All sources matched committed main before execution and remained unchanged afterward. Receipt/log integrity, all seven staged publication files' byte identity and `git diff --check` passed. Attributes preserve the original Windows receipt/capture bytes.

The selected-baseline orientation stopped at sparse-omitted `certificates/checkpoints/frontier4359.json`; no selected-baseline pass, full suite, cold scientific replay or hosted Windows CI is claimed. No frozen acceptance pin is changed.

## Credit

Mihir Srivastava/#4683; Nick Petalas/#2906; ywz65/#2469/#2625/#2579; Paul Romeo/#1484; Aaron Wang/navinor, woklerx, Douglas Colkitt, Tekalign and retained contributors. Prepared for Mihir Srivastava (@mihir-s-05) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, one agent. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

The remaining startup boundary is supervisor termination before Job Object assignment. A bounded next check would pause there, retain the gate waiter's process handle, and assert no workload starts while observing waiter cleanup. These six controls do not cover that window, other Python patches/architectures/free-threaded builds, external launch mechanisms or hostile containment. Proof-relevant child work must still be joined and propagate its failures.

Evidence-only change: seven new files in one directory; existing implementations, tests and selected result are unchanged.
